Which payment services work?
Any service that gives you a payment link: PayPal.me, Venmo, Cash App, Stripe Payment Links, and most checkout pages. The QR code just opens your link.
Is it safe to print a payment link?
The code only opens your public payment link — the same link you would send in a message. Never encode private account details; use the service's official share link.
Can I preset the amount?
Yes, if your payment link supports it (PayPal.me lets you add an amount). The code opens whatever the link contains.
